entries.name: twelve_branch_hand_position
entries.semantics: A twelve-point clockwise mnemonic along finger joints; useful as a paper-hand alternative but not the actual palace-location algorithm.

entries.name: sexagenary_six_xun
entries.semantics: Cycle of 60 combinations grouped in six ten-hour Jia-headed xun: JiaZi, JiaXu, JiaShen, JiaWu, JiaChen, JiaYin.

entries.name: yang_and_yin_solar_term_groups
entries.semantics: 24 solar terms map to yin or yang and upper/middle/lower bureau index; data is transcribed into deterministic table in casting_shenqi.py.

entries.name: futou_yuan_classification
entries.semantics: Find nearest preceding Jia/Ji day fu-tou on sexagenary day chain; classify fu-tou's branch into upper ZiWuMaoYou, middle YinShenSiHai, lower ChenXuChouWei. Do not classify the queried day's own branch.

entries.name: zodiac_hour_ranges
entries.semantics: 12 earthly branches cover 12 successive two-hour local clock periods; Zi spans 23:00 to 00:59, Chou 01:00 to 02:59, ... Hai 21:00 to 22:59. Day rollover ambiguity remains unsolved.

entries.name: five_rat_hour_stems
entries.semantics: For a supplied solar-day stem, determine Zi-hour heavenly stem; each later branch increments stem cyclically.

entries.name: ground_order_nine_stems
entries.semantics: Begin from declared bureau number and step nine-palace integer sequence ascending in Yang or descending in Yin.

entries.name: tianqin_host
entries.semantics: When central TianQin is associated with center fifth palace, it travels paired with TianRui at Kun second palace; each carries its own earth stem. Test case Yin8 places both in palace 8.

entries.name: eight_deities_order
entries.semantics: Place minor deity Zhifu with the great value star, then eight deity sequence clockwise for Yang, anticlockwise for Yin; alternative parentheses GouChen/ZhuQue require future variant note.
